# Run the analysis

Keep the bundled inputs unchanged for your first run. From the main project folder:

```bash
Rscript scripts/R/run_workflow.R data/synthetic results/synthetic
```

The script repeats input checks, creates output directories, then fits a DESeq2 negative binomial model. Rerunning writes to the same named outputs. If an error interrupts the run, check file dates before using results.

## Understand the work

| Step | What the script does | Interpretation |
|---|---|---|
| Sample summary | Sums raw counts and counts genes with value > 0 per sample | Check against the supplied table; these are not overall FASTQ quality metrics |
| Filtering | Keeps genes with counts ≥10 in at least two samples | Removes very low count genes before testing |
| Model | Fits `~ group`, with A as reference | Estimates B versus A, using model-based normalization and dispersion |
| Multiple testing | Saves DESeq2 `padj` | Addresses many tested genes; inspect `NA` values |
| PCA | Variance-stabilizes filtered counts and plots PC1/PC2 | Exploratory display, not a significance test |

## Find the outputs

| File | Inspect |
|---|---|
| `results/synthetic/tables/sample-qc.tsv` | A01's `total_counts` and `detected_genes` |
| `results/synthetic/tables/differential-expression.tsv` | Gene IDs, `log2FoldChange`, `pvalue`, `padj` |
| `results/synthetic/figures/sample-pca.png` | Points, groups, axes and any outlier |
| `results/synthetic/run-log.txt` | Design, contrast, filter, tested genes and R/DESeq2 versions |

The full count matrix has 120 genes, while the DE result contains **tested genes after filtering**. Those counts need not be the same. The fictional groups have no real biological interpretation.

**Checkpoint:** find all four outputs and confirm `group B A` is the recorded contrast.
